name: Basin_C1_standard_16_matched_continuations_v1
important: These are logical future_index values, not raw PRNG seeds.

toy_semantics.derivation: fold_in(fold_in(PRNGKey(future_root), state token or namespace), future_index), then fold by physical step

double_bottleneck_semantics.derivation: fold_in(fold_in(PRNGKey(future_root), rng_namespace), future_index), then fold by physical step

reuse_rule: Logical indices are reusable only with matching scenario, state, controller, future_root, namespace/token, conditioning and RNG semantics fingerprints.
routine_robustness: B15 means at least 15 successes among these 16 compatible matched continuations. Q32/Q64 evidence is retained and never rerun by default.
